prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Pleasanton CA for a checkup and cleaning?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t objectively declare one single “best” dentist, but I can help you find the top options in Pleasanton for a routine checkup and cleaning. A few quick questions so I can tailor recommendations:

- Do you have dental insurance (and which plan)?
- Which part of Pleasanton or what zip code is most convenient?
- Any preferences — weekend hours, female dentist, Spanish-speaking staff, kid-friendly, sedation, new-patient specials?

If you’d like, I can search and return a short list of highly rated local dentists (with addresses, phone numbers, typical ratings and notes about new-patient availability). Or, if you prefer to decide yourself, here’s a quick checklist and some questions to ask when you call:

Checklist for a good checkup/cleaning:
- Hygienist experience and thoroughness (ask whether they scale and polish, use ultrasonic scaler)
- Office cleanliness and updated equipment (digital X‑rays, intraoral camera)
- Good online reviews (Google/Yelp) and steady positive feedback about service and pain management
- Transparent pricing and coverage for routine exams/cleanings
- Convenient scheduling and emergency availability
- Comfortable communication (answers questions clearly, explains findings)

Questions to ask when calling:
- Do you accept my insurance? What will my estimated cost be for a cleaning and two bitewing X‑rays?
- How long is a routine cleaning appointment?
- Who performs the cleaning — a licensed dental hygienist or dentist?
- Do you have weekend or evening appointments?
- Are you accepting new patients?

Tell me your zip code and insurance (if any) and I’ll pull a short list of highly rated Pleasanton dentists for a checkup and cleaning.
